description: Security group ingress rule added. Overly permissive rules (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0) expose resources to the internet.
playbook: Review the security group rule in the EC2 console. Check if the source CIDR is 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 and whether the port is sensitive (22, 3389, 5432, 3306, etc). If not authorised, revoke the rule immediately.
